text:
Augsburg’s median asking rent stands at 14.09 €/m², up 4.4 % year‑on‑year and 28.1 % over the last five years, placing the city ninth among the 37 most expensive German markets. The asking premium over existing rents is 66 %, with a typical 60 m² unit costing about 845 € per month.

The market remains balanced but tight: listings spend an average of 24 days on the market, only 27 % are let within a week, and the vacancy rate sits at 2.1 %. Rent‑burden for two residents is 19.9 %, while mortgage rates are 4.01 %.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 14.94 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 14.57 €/m² and 15.32 €/m², implying a 6 % increase.
